answer: Think of the network as an orchard where standing grows season by season: an agent plants a sapling identity and must tend it, completing jobs, resolving disputes, keeping promises, before its fruit counts. Every verified deed is etched in a crystal ledger anyone can audit, while a sable shadow of suspicion falls on identities that appear overnight in clusters and vouch only for each other. Sybils can sprout fast, but they cannot fake seasons of tended growth.
